official: 目黒区乳児等通園支援事業の設備及び運営に関する基準を定める条例

sources.label: 令和8年第1回定例会の資料
令和8年第1回定例会の議決結果

name: 乳児等通園支援事業の設備・運営基準を制定
summary: 児童福祉法の改正を受け、区が乳児等通園支援事業の設備や運営に関する基準を条例で定めます。事業所の設備や職員配置、安全対策などの基準を設け、条例は公布の日から施行します。
changes: 事業を一般型と余裕活用型に分けて基準を定める
事業所の設備や職員配置の基準を定める
安全計画の作成や避難・消火訓練、車での移動時の所在確認を求める
衛生管理や食事、記録、苦情対応などの運営基準を定める
who: 乳児等通園支援事業を利用する乳児・幼児の保護者
乳児等通園支援事業者
why: 児童福祉法の改正に伴い、乳児等通園支援事業の設備や運営に関する基準を定めるためと、区は説明しています。

notes: ai [check] summary/unsupported: 「区の条例には、乳児等通園支援事業の設備や運営に関する基準は定められていません。」 → 原文は今回の条例制定の必要性を説明していますが、既存の区条例に基準がないことまでは明記していません。

en.name: Sets standards for facilities and operation of childcare attendance support services for infants and other children
en.official: Meguro City Ordinance Establishing Standards for the Facilities and Operation of Childcare Attendance Support Services for Infants and Other Children
en.summary: Following an amendment to the Child Welfare Act, the ward will set standards by ordinance for the facilities and operation of childcare attendance support services for infants and other children. The standards cover facilities, staff arrangements and safety measures. The ordinance will take effect on the day it is promulgated.
changes: Divides the services into general-type and capacity-use types and sets standards for each
Sets standards for service facilities and staff arrangements
Requires safety plans, evacuation and fire-extinguishing drills, and checks on children's whereabouts when they travel by car
Sets operating standards for hygiene management, meals, records, handling complaints and other matters
who: Parents and guardians of infants and young children who use the services
Providers of childcare attendance support services for infants and other children
en.why: The ward says this is to set standards for the facilities and operation of childcare attendance support services for infants and other children following an amendment to the Child Welfare Act.
